snippet.title: Twilight Princess VR is OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
TPVR is out now!

Features:
- Full stereoscopic 3D with controller tracking
- Physical sword swinging, shield bashing and aiming (aim with the right hand)
- Quest 2/3 controller bindings; other headsets are untested
- The ability to play the game in flatscreen for parts you want to skip in VR

Join the Discord to get help, report bugs, request features and talk about the game.

This project is not affiliated with Nintendo or the Twilit Realm (official Dusklight project and its devs).

Github download: https://github.com/JoeyAW/TPVR
SideQuest download: https://sidequestvr.com/app/62532/tpvr

Discord server: https://discord.gg/CxQJ9PjnjA
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/cw/JoeyAW
